text:
I was questioned at my first entry and held for a little bit while they deliberated. It was because i didn't have a return ticket and we had vague plans about who we would stay with. It wasn't so bad, everyone was nice. They just gave me 60 days instead of 90. Later I extended my visa.

I was also questioned at departure last time I left Israel. I just come to it with the expectation that I will be questioned and that's just part of our reality. So i just treat it like a friendly conversation and tell the truth.
